# Beach Metro Community News

> > Beach Metro Community News is a community-focused news publication covering local stories, municipal governance, community services, and resident profiles in Toronto's Beach and East York neighborhoods.

This hyperlocal news outlet serves Toronto's eastern communities with coverage of civic issues, infrastructure projects, community organizations like WoodGreen Community Services, and profiles of local residents and authors. The publication focuses on matters affecting daily life in the Beach, East York, and surrounding areas.

## Key Topics

- Beach Metro Community News
- Toronto municipal governance
- East York community
- Strong mayor system
- WoodGreen Community Services
- Local authors and residents
- Community safety
- Infrastructure and construction
- Homelessness issues
- COVID-19 community response
- Victoria Park and Danforth area
- St. Clair Avenue
- Ivan Forrest Gardens

## Municipal Governance & Civic Issues

- [In My Opinion: Concerns about Toronto's Strong Mayor System are not going away](https://beachmetro.com/2023/01/10/in-my-opinion-concerns-about-torontos-strong-mayor-system-are-not-going-away): Opinion piece on Toronto's strong mayor system and municipal governance
- [St. Clair Avenue construction has East York residents worried about increased traffic on residential streets](https://beachmetro.com/2025/05/21/st-clair-avenue-construction-has-east-york-residents-worried-about-increased-traffic-on-residential-streets): News on St. Clair Ave construction impacts in East York community

## Community Services & Social Issues

- [Tents no longer in Ivan Forrest Gardens park as city staff tries to help those experiencing homelessness](https://beachmetro.com/2020/09/02/tents-no-longer-in-ivan-forrest-gardens-park-as-city-staff-tries-to-help-those-experiencing-homelessness): Coverage of homelessness response at Ivan Forrest Gardens park
- [WoodGreen Community Services continues to help residents in need as they deal with COVID-19](https://beachmetro.com/2020/04/01/woodgreen-community-services-continues-to-help-residents-in-need-as-they-deal-with-covid-19): WoodGreen's COVID-19 pandemic response and community support services
